findings_addressed.oracle: Independent oracle: HuggingFaceProvider.get_pending_usage() must return a non-None UsageInfo with prompt_tokens > 0, completion_tokens > 0, and total_tokens >= prompt_tokens + completion_tokens. This structural contract is verified unconditionally against the live streaming path, matching the non-streaming test pattern in test_live_chat_returns_content_and_usage.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/providers/huggingface.py line 684, change `if usage is not None:` to `if False:` (or delete the block) so _pending_usage is never populated — the assertion `assert usage is not None` at the new test line 147 would fail.

notes: G0259 was a conditional-never-runs finding: the entire usage assertion block was guarded by `if usage is not None:`, which silently passes when the streaming path fails to populate _pending_usage. The fix removes the guard and asserts usage is not None unconditionally, then checks prompt_tokens > 0, completion_tokens > 0, and total_tokens >= prompt_tokens + completion_tokens. Also strengthened chunk assertion to assert len(chunks) > 0 (not just any()) for clarity. No production code was modified.
